calibration_limitation: config/panel_anchors.md is missing. This is the disclosed two-run owner escalation: no anchor scores were invented and no rubric requirement was waived.
audio_assessment_basis: Reports only; no human-listening claim. The supplied measurements report master and square at I=-14.84 LUFS, TP=-2.55 dBTP, LRA=6.1, 38 motivated SFX events with 29 verified audible, a 6.1 dB silence dip, sourced music, and an on-screen composer/license credit.

criterion_notes.Hook & retention: The opening question, hand, paper wave, and waiting lever communicate the conflict immediately. The 131-second argument continues to add concrete beats, though the repeated pale-card compositions create a modest middle sag.
criterion_notes.Illustration craft & detail: Clean thick-ink clinic-paper art, form-shaded clothing and machinery, contact shadows, small material cues, and consistent finish parity make the frames intentional within the brand style. Reused figures and broad quiet backgrounds keep it below showcase-level detail.
criterion_notes.Motion & animation craft: All 38 registered eight-frame strips were inspected. They prove in-shot movement and several strong transformations, but many changes are small or confined to one prop; held figures repeatedly lack clearly visible full-body idle or gesture cycles. This is above static slideshow craft but below the rubric's mostly-alive 7 descriptor.
criterion_notes.Composition & staging: Strong focal hierarchy, safe central silhouettes, clear recording-versus-note and yes-versus-no spatial comparisons, and disciplined caption/title zones. Repetition of the centered room/card template limits visual surprise.
criterion_notes.Color & grade: The warm cream, mint, deep green, mustard, and coral world suits a careful clinical-consent story and avoids default blue. Cohesion and subtle grain are good; the low-contrast pale field is deliberately restrained rather than richly filmic.
criterion_notes.Typography & captions: Headlines, labels, caveats, and open captions are consistently readable in the reviewed full frames; the objective report also passes HUD and caption edge-energy checks. Type behavior is mostly static, so kinetic intent is limited.
criterion_notes.Sound design & mix: Report-based grade only. Loudness, peak, and range pass; motivated events span every shot, the silence dip is measured, music is sourced, and Kevin MacLeod is credited on screen. Nine of 38 scheduled events are not reported as verified audible, preventing a top-tier score.
criterion_notes.VO–illustration sync & entertainment: The picture follows the spoken consent, note, reuse, retention, refusal, and care-continuity logic beat for beat. It is clear and watchable, but repeated staging and small-motion beats keep it from feeling consistently gripping.
criterion_notes.Accuracy & sourcing: Fourteen claims are scoped to two primary TCC pages, with announcement terms explicitly separated from audits, measured outcomes, chart notes, and possible reuse. Most load-bearing claims rely on one first-party announcement rather than two independent sources, so this does not earn the 10 descriptor.
criterion_notes.Alaska authenticity & cultural respect: The film names Interior Alaska and Tanana Chiefs Conference, stays pro-patient and pro-useful-AI without savior framing, and uses no unverified Native language or iconography. The human imagery is generic rather than deeply place-specific.
criterion_notes.Writing & post quality: The VO and post take a clear, nuanced position, preserve the strongest case and honest limitation, distinguish all relevant data objects, and end with a real question. The exact post passes its objective lint and remains concise for LinkedIn despite substantive detail.

verdict: PASS. The exact graded bytes clear the 7.0 threshold at 7.782 with no evidenced hard blocker. Motion craft is the principal revision opportunity, but the current evidence supports shipping.
